gates.name: source admission
gates.input: finite source bytes, declared language, logical path and finite resource budget
gates.pass: an IntakeRecord binds raw and normalised hashes, UTF-8 text and physical lines
gates.fail: typed refusal; no substitute bytes or silent decoding repair
invariants: file identity checked before and after read

gates.name: observation availability
gates.pass: one of observed, not_applicable, insufficient_evidence or unavailable; observed iff value is non-null
gates.fail: state/value mismatch or missing typed reason

gates.name: value and codomain conformance
gates.input: an observation under a versioned specification
gates.pass: atomic finite value, unit, codomain and measurement scale match the specification
gates.fail: domain, bound, unit or scale violation
invariants: McCabe-style C is ordinal in specification 1.2.0

gates.name: source-evidence adequacy
gates.input: evidence identifiers bound to normalised source and coordinates
gates.pass: structural evidence admission and, where required, coordinate coverage of all visited spans
gates.fail: unknown evidence, wrong scope or uncovered visited span
invariants: structural validity is not treated as coordinate completeness

gates.name: policy interpretation
gates.input: observed value, accepted profile identity and applicable rule
gates.pass: versioned non-compensatory decision vector with declared threshold set
gates.fail: profile mismatch, undeclared threshold or non-applicable rule treated as a decision
invariants: endpoint reduction applies only to monotone x>t

gates.name: consumer admission and source replay
gates.input: producer record, consumer schema/identifier grammar and declared source/profile/build for replay
gates.pass: accepted envelope or replay agreement; aliases preserve original source identity
gates.fail: typed rejection, replay mismatch or identity loss

propositions.name: selected non-substitution
propositions.statement: For named gates Gi,Gj, one admissible witness with Gi=PASS and Gj=FAIL refutes Gi=>Gj on the declared domain.
propositions.qualification: Five selected implications only; no all-pairs or statistical independence claim.

propositions.name: threshold partition
propositions.statement: For T=[L,U]∩Z and D_T(x)={1[x>t]:t∈T}, x<=L gives {0}, L<x<=U gives {0,1}, x>U gives {1}.
propositions.qualification: Middle region is empty when L=U.

propositions.name: endpoint sufficiency
propositions.statement: For monotone x>t, the image over the full integer interval is determined by endpoints L and U.

propositions.name: scale repair
propositions.statement: d is ratio-scale count; C=1+d preserves order and differences but not ratios, so C is declared ordinal conservatively.

propositions.name: identity separation
propositions.statement: record_id hashes versioned specification and logical entity; measurement_digest hashes deterministic content without path metadata.
propositions.qualification: record_id is scoped within a measurement result and is not globally unique.

propositions.name: numeric decision
propositions.statement: Exact decimals pass iff delta<=max(abs_tol,rel_tol*max(|a|,|b|)); binary64 overlap with the boundary is indeterminate.

obligations.obligation: The six gates have distinct typed domains and pass/fail conditions.
Each asserted non-implication has a named witness whose predecessor passes and target fails.
obligations.method: Validate P3 witness results and witness preconditions

obligations.obligation: Threshold-set partition is correct for every admissible integer L,U,x.
obligations.method: Proof plus exhaustive bounded comparison of implementation to full interval

obligations.obligation: Three stored levels are extensionally equivalent to the full integer interval for monotone x>t.
Ratio statements about C=1+d are inadmissible because the offset changes ratios.
record_id is invariant to evidence/content changes within the same specification/entity slot, while measurement_digest changes with content.
Decimal comparison is symmetric, reflexive and deterministic with inclusive equality; binary boundary overlap cannot pass.
obligations.method: Exact Decimal and half-ULP interval tests

obligations.obligation: Observed/null and non-observed/non-null combinations are rejected.
No retained claim requires prevalence, causal effect, economic value or universal correctness.
